1.name: KQCircuits
1.scope: straight CPW gap-mask generation and independent geometric readback only; no EM simulation or full-toolkit claim
1.acceptance: Two CLI executions on each of macOS, Windows and Linux; 12 reports and 18 GDS files independently re-read after download, zero mask XOR, correct units and area. Tool execution only; solver_evidence is the legacy completion-field name, not an EM claim.
remaining_scope: Electrical simulation, convergence and physical validation

2.name: Qiskit Metal / Quantum Metal
2.scope: centred positive charge-pad and ground-pocket masks with typed dimensions; no fabrication junction, EM or full-toolkit claim
2.acceptance: Two requests run twice on macOS, Windows and Linux. All twelve GDS packets independently re-read after download with correct units/layers and zero mask XOR. Tool execution only; solver_evidence is a legacy completion-field name.
remaining_scope: Other components, connectors, rotations and configurable layers

3.name: pyEPR
3.scope: specified ideal one-mode full-cosine circuit diagonalization, two charge-insensitive benchmarks; no EM/HFSS extraction or measurement validation
3.acceptance: Typed CLI: two cases twice on macOS, Windows and Linux; all 12 packets independently hash-checked and compared with fresh charge-basis calculations. Fixed 1 Hz refinement/dispersion and 2 Hz reference gates pass. Maximum reported reference difference 0.003927231 Hz; unchanged repeats identical. Exact implementation CI and test workflows passed.
remaining_scope: Broader parameter-domain validation and measured-device comparison

4.name: CircuitQ
4.scope: specified ideal parallel LC circuit with SI/natural matrix equivalence and two repeated numerical benchmarks; no nonlinear/noise, EM or measurement claim
4.acceptance: Two typed CLI cases twice on Windows/macOS/Linux, all 12 downloaded packets independently hash-checked and re-evaluated against exact LC references and raw joule energies. Fixed residual/Hermiticity/grid/domain/reference limits passed. Worst frequency error 6.250648055 ppm; same-platform repeats identical. Exact implementation CI and test passed.

5.name: scqubits
5.scope: two fixed ideal ng=0 transmon spectra via the typed SI adapter, with cutoff/residual/Mathieu checks; no noise, EM, measurement or full-toolkit claim
5.acceptance: Two cases at three cutoffs, repeated on macOS/Windows/Linux: six benchmark packets, 36 typed adapter executions. All raw hashes, SI inputs, eigenpairs, canonical values and fresh Mathieu references independently checked. Fixed 1 Hz refinement/reference and 1e-12 scaled residual gates passed; worst reference difference 0.000167847 Hz. Same-platform repeats identical. Exact implementation CI/test passed.
remaining_scope: Other charge offsets and broader parameter domains
